info.title: SportBook API
info.description:
REST API of the SportBook venue booking platform. The API Gateway forwards requests to the User, Venue and Booking microservices over RabbitMQ RPC.

**Auth:** call `POST /user/login`, then click **Authorize** and paste the token.

**Payments:** when `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY` is configured, paid slots are booked as `pending_payment` and `POST /bookings/create` returns a `checkout_url` (Stripe Checkout). The slot is held for 30 minutes; the booking becomes `booked` once Stripe confirms the payment (webhook or `GET /payments/verify` on return). Cancelling a paid booking refunds it in full.

post.description: The slot is reserved atomically: of two concurrent requests for the same slot only one succeeds, the other gets 409. The price is fixed at booking time. With payments enabled the booking is returned as `pending_payment` together with `checkout_url`; redirect the player there. Without payments (or for admins / free slots) it is `booked` immediately.
